name: Solo Utilities
description: Enhance the Solo theme with additional features, utilities, and customization options for advanced site building.
project_description:

 Solo Utilities 
 Solo Utilities is a module designed to enhance the Solo theme with additional features and customization options. The initial release of Solo Utilities introduces the ability to set custom widths for individual nodes, giving site builders and content creators more control over the presentation of their content. Future updates will include new features to further enhance the Solo theme.

 FEATURES 
 
 Custom Node Widths: Set custom widths for individual nodes to tailor the display of your content. 
 Dynamic Color Schemes with Solo Theme: Enhance your website's appearance with the Solo theme’s dynamic color scheme feature. With 50 unique color schemes available, you can customize the look and feel of your site based on content types, taxonomies, user roles, and specific URLs. This feature allows for a visually cohesive and tailored user experience, making your site stand out with color schemes that change dynamically to suit different contexts. To utilize this feature, ensure the Solo Utilities module is enabled and that the Solo theme or any of its sub-themes is set as the default theme or part of the active theme hierarchy. Start customizing your site's appearance today and create an engaging and unique visual experience for all your visitors. 
 Future Enhancements: Solo Utilities will be updated with new features that enhance the Solo theme. 
 
 Back to top 

 REQUIREMENTS 
 
 Solo theme 
 Node module 
 
 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 
 Download and place the Solo Utilities module in the modules/custom directory of your Drupal installation. 
 Enable the module using Drush or the Drupal admin interface:
 
 Using Drush: drush en solo_utilities -y 
 Using Drupal Admin Interface: Navigate to Extend , find the Solo Utilities module, enable it, and save the configuration. 
 
 
 
 Back to top 

 CONFIGURATION 
 
 Ensure the Solo theme is active and configured correctly. 
 Navigate to the theme settings of the Solo theme. 
 If the Solo Utilities module is enabled, you will see an option to enable custom widths for individual nodes. 
 Configure the settings as needed. 
 
 Back to top 

 USAGE 
 
 When creating or editing a node, you will see a dropdown to select a custom width for the node. 
 Choose the desired width or select "None" to use the default width.
